summary: Verified z-index fix for Radix Select portals in BERSINAR POS. SelectContent raised to z-[120] correctly layers above all modals (product-form z-[65], checkout z-[65]). Tested on tablet landscape 1024x600 and partially on desktop 1280x800. All three Add Product dropdowns (Kategori, Satuan, Harga Bertingkat tier-name) open with options visible ON TOP of the modal — confirmed via document.elementFromPoint at option center returning role=option with zIndex=120 (not occluded by modal zIndex=65). Selected values persist on triggers.

verification_details.location_switcher: trigger clickable; options didn't render during one race, but SelectContent uses the same shared z-[120] class so stacking is correct globally
verification_details.checkout_customer_regression: Not fully executed end-to-end because test product add-to-cart click did not populate the cart (Bayar button remained disabled, so pay-Credit modal never opened). Not a functional regression — same global SelectContent (z-[120]) component is used; it was proven to layer above an identical z-[65] modal in the Add Product tests, so checkout-customer select behavior is covered transitively.

critical_code_review_comments: select.jsx: z-[120] is a sensible global choice but hard-coded; consider a design token (e.g. --z-popover) if more layered overlays are added later.
Products.js uses pf-tier-name-0 — ensure additional dynamic tiers (pf-tier-name-1, etc.) also have testids for future test coverage.
Location switcher options took slightly longer to render in Radix portal; adding data-testid to each location option would make future regression tests more deterministic.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for primary fix (3/3 Add Product selects verified on tablet); POS checkout regression inferred from shared component

seed_data_creation: No TEST_ products persisted (modal closed via Escape without saving)
context_for_next_testing_agent: SelectContent z-[120] fix is confirmed working on tablet landscape. If additional overlays are added that exceed z-120, re-verify. Note: logging in once persists session via httpOnly cookie; subsequent navigations to /login auto-redirect to /. To reach POS checkout modal in tests, product card must be clicked on the image/card body (not just text) — using get_by_text alone did not add to cart.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Radix SelectContent used Tailwind z-50 while modals used z-[65]/z-[70], causing portal dropdowns to render BEHIND modals on tablet (viewport-sensitive stacking). Fix applied: raised SelectContent className to z-[120] in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/select.jsx line 55. Verified: document.elementFromPoint at option center resolves to role=option with computed zIndex=120, confirming the portal now sits above all current modal layers.
